$$|V| - 2\nu(G) = \max_{S \subseteq V}\bigl(o(G - S) - |S|\bigr)$$
where $o(G-S)$ is the number of odd components of $G - S$. Equivalently, $2\nu(G) = \min_{S \subseteq V}\bigl(450 + |S| - o(G-S)\bigr)$. We must bound $o(G-S) - |S|$ for all $S$.
